greeting.text: Another recruit? You don't look like much. Let's see if you can change my mind.

responses.text: I want to learn to fight.

rowan_sent.text: Did he now? Old man's got a soft spot for strays. Fine. Grab a practice sword. We start now.

responses.text: I need a moment to prepare.

training_offer.text: Good. Self-awareness is step one. I can teach you to stay alive. The rest is up to you.

responses.text: How did you learn to fight?

training_details.text: Stance. Timing. How to read an enemy. Fancy moves get you killed. Fundamentals keep you breathing.

training_start.text: Eyes up. Guard high. And for the love of all things holy, stop telegraphing your swings.

training_result.text: Not terrible. You didn't fall over, which puts you ahead of the last three recruits. Again.

advanced_training.text: Faster this time. A goblin won't wait for you to find your footing. React or die. Simple as that.

training_complete.text: Huh. You might actually survive out there. Don't let it go to your head. Come back when you want more.

responses.text: I want to spar. For real.

honest_assessment.text: Raw, but there's something there. You've got instincts. Training will sharpen them into something lethal.

combat_tips.text: Block before you strike. Watch the shoulders, not the weapon. And never, ever turn your back.

tip_multiple.text: Keep moving. Force them into a line so you fight one at a time. Goblins are stupid enough to bunch up.

tip_retreat.text: Run. No shame in retreating. Dead heroes don't save anyone. Live to fight smarter next time.

responses.text: You don't seem the type to run.

kira_pride.text: I've run plenty. That's why I'm still here teaching you. Pride is a luxury the dead can't afford.

responses.text: How did you learn all this?

prove_it.text: Words are cheap. Steel isn't. Pick up a practice blade and show me what you've got.

responses.text: Maybe I should warm up first.

spar_challenge.text: A real bout? Alright, hotshot. Don't cry when you eat dirt. Best of three. Ready?

responses.text: Actually, let me train more first.

spar_result.text: Well, well. You actually landed a hit. Most people can't touch me. You've earned my attention, recruit.

responses.text: You're incredible. How long have you trained?

kira_backstory.text: Grew up on a border fort. Bandits every week. Learned to fight before I could read. It's all I know.

responses.text: Let's put that experience to work. Train me.

why_hearthholm.text: Rowan asked. Said this town needed a fighter, not just soldiers. Couldn't say no to the old bear.

end_respect.text: Not bad, recruit. Come back tomorrow. We'll make a warrior out of you yet.

end.text: Don't take too long. The goblins won't wait for you to be ready.
